topic: Exploring the 2-adic Metric: Where Distance Defies Intuition

sections.title: The Familiar World: Real Convergence
lecture_lines: Real convergence: distance shrinks towards a target.
Imagine a squirrel hopping towards an acorn.
animations: Fade in a point representing 2 on a line. Color: #FFFFFF.
Animate a squirrel [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/squirrel.svg] moving from 2 towards 1. Color: #00FF00.
Display distances 1/2, 1/4, 1/8 shrinking on screen next to an acorn [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/acorn.svg]. Color: #FF00FF.

sections.title: The 2-adic Lens: Changing the Rules
lecture_lines: 2-adic valuation: size based on divisibility by two.
Many factors of two make numbers small.
See 16 shrink closer to zero than 2.
A magnifying glass reveals this hidden scale.
Numbers with more powers of two feel smaller.
animations: Display |x|_2 and fade in a number. Color: #FFFFFF.
Show the number 16 decomposed as 2^4. Color: #FFFF00.
Highlight how 2^4 results in a smaller 2-adic norm. Color: #00FF00.
Display 2 and 16 with their respective sizes compared. Color: #FF0000.

sections.title: Infinite Sums in 2-adic Space
lecture_lines: Each term is smaller in 2-adic space.
Partial sums settle as binary digits flip.
It approaches the value negative one.
animations: Show the infinite sum expression 1 + 2 + 4. Color: #FFFFFF. [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/none.svg]
Animate each term 2^n getting smaller in 2-adic space. Color: #FF00FF.
Visualize partial sums accumulating towards -1. Color: #00FF00.
Highlight how the sum stabilizes unlike real numbers. Color: #FFFF00.
Reveal the final result -1 prominently on screen. Color: #00FFFF. [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/none.svg]

sections.title: The Ultrametric Inequality
lecture_lines: Ultrametric inequality: distance defies standard triangle intuition.
Triangles are always isosceles with short bases.
You cannot exceed the deepest tunnel's depth.
animations: Show the text: |x + y|_2 <= max(|x|_2, |y|_2). Color: #FFFFFF.
Draw a triangle with three vertices using the geometry structure [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/tunnel.svg]. Color: #00FF00.
Highlight the two equal long sides of the triangle. Color: #FF00FF.
